articles.title: Trusted Interdependence: India's next step in defence self-reliance
articles.summary: The Modi government has progressively evolved its defence industrial strategy since 2014, emphasizing 'Make in India' for self-reliance. Initiatives like defence industrial corridors and simplified licensing aim to boost indigenous manufacturing. This multi-phase approach seeks to reduce import dependence, enhance domestic production, and strengthen India's defence capabilities, fostering strategic autonomy and technological growth.

articles.title: Additive manufacturing: transforming submarine maintenance and support
articles.summary: The Defence Nuclear Enterprise's Submarine Delivery Group (SDG) is leveraging advanced and additive manufacturing techniques. This initiative aims to significantly enhance submarine availability, thereby improving operational readiness and efficiency for the fleet. By adopting cutting-edge manufacturing processes, SDG is optimizing parts production and maintenance, ensuring the UK's vital submarine capabilities remain robust and deployable for national security.
